name: Koshchei
desc: A bio-alchemist and researcher from Hvergelmir. He is also known as Doctor Moreau.

customize.name: Belyi Tsar
customize.desc: Monomakh Snezhnyi was the Tsar of all Fae and the first Cryo Archon.

customize.text: Koshchei the Deathless was convicted of experiments on Fae more than 500 years ago, but was pardoned by order of the Belyi Tsar.

customize.name: Aksinya
customize.desc: The leading researcher of Hvergelmir, who created the Eye of Graeae and worked on the creation of the Primordial Human.

customize.name: Pavlina
customize.desc: Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka from the House of Hesperides.

customize.text: in the project to create the Court of Bliss and to make the Belyi Tsar the Primordial Human.

customize.name: Proto-Man
customize.desc: The Key, created as a result of countless experiments, was supposed to help the Belyi Tsar become the Primordial Human.

customize.text: A prototype created by Koshchei and the Key that was supposed to help the Belyi Tsar become the Primordial Human. When the Proto-Man persuaded Koshchei, Pavlina, and Alvis to betray Aksinya and split himself into three parts, Koshchei received a fragment of the Proto-Man's power.

customize.name: Zver
customize.desc: The leader of the bio-alchemically created monsters in service of the Belyi Tsar.

customize.text: One of two intelligent Koshchei's prototypes. Koshchei considered Zver a half-formed creation and therefore abandoned him. In the end, that unfinished form was fused with the seeds of other monsters. Before Zver could be unmade as a failed experiment, the Belyi Tsar, believing that no being with sentience should be so discarded, decided to take the creature into his service.

customize.name: Chimeric Armored Beast
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster.
If a four-legged beast were given a carapace and charging horn like those of an Onikabuto, it might well become a shock force capable of breaking through enemy formations.
In theory, man-made monsters designed around a single function rarely survive in the wild. Once they lose the place or purpose for which they were made, most perish for having defied the laws of nature. Clearly, however, the Armored Beast is not one of them.
Today, on the frozen lands of Snezhnaya, Armored Beasts can often be seen hunting in packs.

customize.name: Chimeric Burrowbeast
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster.
If a monster that burrows and moves through earth and snow were granted vision that could see all within the shadows, could it become an even stronger predator?
The experiment proved astonishingly successful. These Burrowbeasts move beneath the surface at night, digging traps in the dark or hiding in the shadows to hunt.
According to a report in Vestnik, a worker living in Svetloledovka once saw a giant Burrowbeast nearly as tall as two people... though that is probably nothing more than a wild rumor.

customize.name: Chimeric Winged Elephant
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster.
A short-legged elephant with wings could likely migrate without being restricted by terrain, and would also be able to reach fruit growing in higher places.
For that purpose alone, its creator brought such a beast into being. Later, during the war against the dark tide, Chimeric Winged Elephants worked alongside the Vila in intelligence and communications, ensuring that the Belyi Tsar's commands could pass smoothly and swiftly as his army advanced.

customize.name: Chimeric Horned Bear
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy, a man-made monster with an exceptionally unusual formation.
A man-made monster not formed according to its creator's design, but through the spontaneous assembly of life segments. As a result, it came to possess certain wondrous traits, including the ability to freely wield elemental power.
Even if life is broken down until almost nothing remains but segments, could some will or power still guide them to grow according to a mysterious plan?
Perhaps no one knows the answer to that by now.

customize.name: Immortal Construct
customize.desc:
A byproduct created by the alchemist Koshchei during his creation of the individual known as the Firebird.
Perhaps this was the gloomy alchemist's habit: whenever one experimental subject from a batch succeeded, all the others would be abandoned or disposed of as he pleased.
This derivative creation should have fused with some form of power and reached completion. Now, however, it can only wander endlessly through the mountain gorges as an incomplete, mindless beast.

customize.name: Chimeric Winged Lion
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy, one of the man-made monsters that was abandoned.
To bring a certain great wish to fruition, an alchemist created numerous primordial bodies known as "Prototypes" through a technique that must never be retold.
Of these, only one successfully grew into the perfect creation he had planned. The others, though close to perfection, ultimately failed, and were carelessly remade into two-headed monsters.
Though regarded as failures, these special two-headed monsters still possess tremendous power. Among chimeras, there is nothing that can stand against them.

customize.text:
Koshchei's bio-alchemical creations.
Okurov
A village where Koshchei transformed its inhabitants into the Perfect Tree. Their bodies turned into algae, and their minds merged into a life that transcended time and all existence.

customize.name: Furiosa
customize.desc: A Volkodlak archer who once nearly lost her life. After undergoing alchemical modification, her body's strength surpassed the limits of living beings, and she gained a measure of authority over trees. She was meant to cast off her former body and fully transform into a life-form beyond time, one closer to eternity. But at the final moment, she chose to abandon that path. And so, she remains in a state as though her body has been parasitized by trees.

customize.text: Koshchei's transformed "patient" in Okurov. After undergoing alchemical modification, her body's strength surpassed the limits of living beings, and she gained a measure of authority over trees. She was meant to cast off her former body and fully transform into a life-form beyond time, one closer to eternity. But at the final moment, she chose to abandon that path. And so, she remains in a state as though her body has been parasitized by trees.

customize.name: Nastya
customize.desc: A resident of Okurov, transformed by Koshchei's experiments.

customize.text: A resident of Okurov, who became a Perfect Tree of her own will.

customize.name: Pebble of Serpentine Algae
customize.desc:
An egg-shaped stone infused with the power required for the Eye of Graeae to reclaim his physical form.
Once used by the alchemist named Koshchei to create life in pursuit of eternity.
Hidden within it may lie the revelation of how a mere mortal might forge immortality through rebirth.

customize.name: Proto-Man
customize.desc: The Key, created as a result of countless experiments, was supposed to help the Belyi Tsar become the Primordial Human.

customize.name: Eye of Graeae
customize.desc:
A strange mechanism you encountered in an abandoned station. It often appears in the form of a monocle.

It offers many convenient functions, such as recording blueprints for Prime Ice constructs, creating Prime Ice, calling trains.

...Perhaps it was built for the very purpose of providing all these conveniences.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd680>About Koshchei</color>
Material regarding Koshchei turns up... a verdict from five hundred and thirty years ago: "[...] Enforcement Office, Regarding the Verdict on [...]."
The defendant was charged with using living fae for alchemical experiments...
The defendant's name was Koshchei. The evidence was solid, but there exists no record of his final execution... Perhaps he simply shares a name with this Koshchei. Besides this, no other records are available...
<color=#ffd680>Tell me about Koshchei...</color>
<color=#36ffff>Eye of Graeae</color> : The alchemist, Koshchei the Deathless... To think this was his end...
<color=#36ffff>Eye of Graeae</color> : He transformed his life into a nigh-eternal form... because my fragmented body was insufficient to support his complete transcendence.
<color=#36ffff>Eye of Graeae</color> : He merely referenced the power in said fragment of my body, and spent not a drop of it, instead setting up a ritual that covered all of Flamefeather Valley...
<color=#36ffff>Eye of Graeae</color> : It's almost as if he was waiting... waiting for someone to come and take it from him...
<color=#36ffff>Eye of Graeae</color> : He pursued eternity on... account of "love"?
<color=#36ffff>Traveler</color> : But he forgot "love" in the end...
<color=#36ffff>Eye of Graeae</color> : Perhaps he had too much trust... too much faith in the greatness of his "private love." But so it proved that the love he madly sought to pursue through eternity was silenced by eternity. Time... Time and change are destructive indeed...
<color=#36ffff>Eye of Graeae</color> : "Time and change ravage all things. Every passing second erodes the permanence of love."

customize.name: Belyi Tsar
customize.desc: Monomakh Snezhnyi was the Tsar of all Fae and the first Cryo Archon.

customize.name: Zver
customize.desc: The leader of the bio-alchemically created monsters in service of the Belyi Tsar.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd680>About the murder of Solovei</color>
<color=#36ffff>Belyi Tsar</color> : The details of the matter are already known to me — Aksinya and Koshchei have given their report. The eldest son of the House Solovyov chanced upon something he shouldn't have... And the fault clearly lies with the two of them.
<color=#36ffff>Belyi Tsar</color> : Your actions have spared Koshchei and the others a rather significant headache.
<color=#36ffff>Zver</color> : Me? But helping him was the furthest thing from my mind! I only acted to... ensure that Your Majesty's private affairs remained entirely inviolable.
<color=#36ffff>Belyi Tsar</color> : And yet, you owe your very existence to him, Zver. Perhaps he alone deserves the title of your father.
That is indeed true, Your Majesty. It was he who created me, gave me this deficient mind and a tongue with which to speak.
<color=#36ffff>Zver</color> : Yet, that has not stopped him from looking upon me... as a flawed creation that should have been destroyed from the very beginning. Your Majesty...
<color=#36ffff>Zver</color> : Must a creation forever bend the knee to its creator? Surely, even an imperfect being like myself cannot be expected to endure the neglect, the contempt, and the unending wrath of the one who fashioned me?
<color=#36ffff>Zver</color> : Must the thing created... always walk the path its maker has laid out, and bow to his every caprice?
<color=#36ffff>Belyi Tsar</color> : ...
<color=#36ffff>Zver</color> : Ah, I wasn't speaking of y——
<color=#36ffff>Belyi Tsar</color> : None of that bears weight here, Zver. None of it. There are times when the sole matter of consequence is the path one resolves to take.

desc.text:
...The core challenge in retaining the characteristics of two or more organisms within a single individual is, in truth, the question of maintaining different circulatory systems within a single body.
Ordinary bio-alchemy can solve this problem via an artificial organ known as the Prime Chimeric Nexus.
After resolving the corresponding rejection reactions, one can allow embryos with different properties to form an internal circulatory system specific to the embryonic organism via this organ.
Once a system is formed, the different "components" of the different embryos can be combined during growth, resulting in a Chimeric Beast.
The Prime Chimeric Nexus can only support up to three different embryo types... This is the limit, according to accepted knowledge.
Aksinya says the data indicates the limit is, in fact, five. I made a bet with her that if she can indeed create a Prime Chimeric Nexus that supports five embryos, I will take her to Podvorye Restaurant for drinks in secret.
...
The Embryonic-Ichoric-Telluric-Rudiment (henceforth "Eitr") has changed everything. It is as if we have obtained the final form of the Prime Chimeric Nexus.
It is like a living bio-furnace that can devour any living embryo without limitations.
And its products are nothing like the previous Chimeric Beasts, which had to undergo nurturing cycles to await their growth and harmonization before reaching a completed stage.
Instead, the Eitr swallows, then fully absorbs the embryos, and directly reconstructs their biological traits. And even with that, the number of circulatory systems remains but one.
This must have been the foundation stone for developing a sort of perfect life form.
...
The Eitr is indeed the most perfect of all Hyperborean creations. Its sole weakness is that it is far too perfect...
To the point where it cannot preserve the special components of each organism, as would occur using the Prime Chimeric Nexus.
Perhaps we should consider ways to isolate the biological characteristics from organisms formed from the Eitr?
Ah, I get it now. This must be why the Hyperboreans only created the Leshy in the later stages of their Eitr research...
They must have turned away from the Eitr's bio-furnace in search of more stable forms of life, ones closer to eternity...
...
The five-embryo-compatible Prime Chimeric Nexus that Aksinya constructed only lasted a few breaths in a stable state.
I warned her that this was a low-probability coincidence involving multiple factors that could not be replicated.
She said, "But your bet was about whether or not it could support five embryo types!"
I said that this technology was purely developed for our bet, with neither practical applications nor developmental potential.
She said, "But your bet was about whether or not it could support five embryo types!"
...
She didn't want to drink at all. She only ordered some non-alcoholic soft drinks at Podvorye Restaurant.
I spent more Mora bribing the Pale Crown Palace guards than she spent on drinks. Seriously, what an unreasonable woman.
...Perhaps she just wanted to take a look outside the palace?

...The experiment is complete.
Aksinya believes it finished as per its designated direction, and thus, a success. And indeed, it is a grand endeavor most worthy of praise.
But can this really be called a success?
So-called eternal love... the so-called courtyard of eternal bliss...
Is that is not merely a dead end with neither change nor improvement?
...
What "shared love"? Is this the world she desires, where all shall love all... Yet love should not be such a thing.
If all differences in this world were to disappear, and all were to be blended into one, what would we be "loving," precisely?
There would be nothing to project love outward upon, nor would there be any corresponding entity within to love.
A "love" created by removing the key elements behind love is nothing but a falsehood, an empty shell.
...
The person within the egg is right.
"He" speaks truth. Aksinya has not perceived the terrifying essence of eternal love.
I cannot... allow her plan to come to final fruition. His Majesty Monomakh has passed, but I know she has not given up simply on that account...
Before the time comes, we must stop her. The person within the egg... I agree with "his" plan.
I know, however, that she will one day surely return, breaking free from the shackles of the land of shadows.
When that time comes, I shall prove to her... that love will not be eroded by cold silence, not even in the grand scheme of eternity.

"...The sutured wound on the right arm is healing well... The atrophied muscles are beginning to regain their vitality..."
"Trunk development stable... No abnormal reactions detected..."
"New branches and leaves have completely enveloped the existing body... Unnecessary memories and emotions are gradually fading away..."

"...I did not expect the fae [...] so adaptable. Could it be because the Hyperboreans had left some kind of access point behind when they first created them...?"
"A body formed from trees can regrow after being damaged, and also grant the subject strength far beyond that of their original body. However, its language capabilities will regress..."
"After all, there's not much pain to speak of anymore."
"The experiments conducted in the sewers have yielded sufficient data. Now, we must find a way to slowly make the townspeople accept this..."
"Certainly, once they see the 'treatment' Furiosa has undergone, there will always be some poor souls tormented by illness who will want to try it out for themselves..."

...The final ceremony is about to start, and soon, just like me, everyone shall be reborn from embryo. This is how the very ultimate form of life is born.
Some of the townspeople do not seem to agree [...] But their understanding is not something we can demand. Besides, on the scale of the eternal...
...regard every happening as something that would have happened anyway. And in a world where all possibilities happen, everything loses its meaning. Pain, sorrow, despair, envy, they all become inconsequential. Because it was all bound to happen.
Hope, joy, laughter — these, too, will lose all color alongside. But these are all things mankind is behooved to cast aside anyway. But perhaps... love will not fade away.
...Oh, Aksinya. The only sin of the world you have so wrongly pursued is its "love of sameness."
How can one make you understand... the love of the individual? That love is the one thing that must never be reduced to sameness even if you choose to abandon it in the end...

(A note, written in an elegant hand...)
"I will be returning to the House of Hesperides for the next few days, so I'll leave the cat in your care. I can hardly trust the others with her, given how absorbed they become in their experiments."
"I am sure my colleague Koshchei shares my respect for living things and will remember to feed my Lara... The key and specially prepared cat food are on your desk."
"P.S. If I find that my cat has not been properly fed, or that she has somehow grown parts from another animal, I will find out who is responsible. — Pavlina"
"...And remember, my Lara only eats from her bowl. Please don't scatter her food on the floor. She won't eat anything off the floor."
